怎样把空气里的氮又快、又多、又省地变成氨？: How do we turn the nitrogen in air into ammonia quickly, in quantity and cheaply?
低温高压 → 装得下更多氨: Low temperature, high pressure → more ammonia at equilibrium
高温 + 铁触媒 → 反应更快: High temperature + iron catalyst → faster reaction
设备强度与能耗 → 压力有上限: Equipment strength and energy use → pressure has a ceiling

H₂S 等硫化物 → 铁触媒中毒: H₂S and other sulfides → iron catalyst poisoning
Ar 等惰性气体在这里累积: Ar and other inert gases build up here

N₂ 与 H₂ 在铁表面吸附 → 解离 → 成键 → 脱附；催化剂只改这条路快不: N₂ and H₂ adsorb on the iron surface → dissociate → form bonds → desorb; the catalyst only changes how fast this path is, not where it ends.
催化剂只改这条路走得快不快，不改终点在哪——平衡转化率一点没变。: The catalyst only changes how fast the path is travelled, not where it ends: the equilibrium conversion does not change at all.
空气里到处是氮气，为什么还要建这么大一座厂才能变成氨？: Nitrogen is everywhere in the air. Why does it take such a huge plant to turn it into ammonia?
拖动视角，绕着厂区看一圈（滚轮拉近拉远）: Drag the view to orbit the plant (scroll to zoom)
参考工况 450 ℃ / 25 MPa / r 2.8：产率 26.8 t/h: Reference conditions 450 ℃ / 25 MPa / r 2.8: output 26.8 t/h running, NH₃ equilibrium content 31.7 %, utilization 97.0 %
总式左边没有现成原料：H₂ 靠 CH₄ 与水蒸气转化，N₂ 靠空气液化分馏。: The left side of the overall equation has no ready-made feedstock: H₂ comes from reforming CH₄ with steam, N₂ from liquefying and fractionating air.
反应可逆、放热、气体分子数减少：想「多」要低温高压，想「快」要高温和铁触媒。: The reaction is reversible, exothermic and reduces the number of gas molecules: "more" needs low temperature and high pressure, "faster" needs high temperature and an iron catalyst.
两个要求打架，工程上只能折中，折出一条五段流水线。: The two demands conflict, so engineering compromises, and the compromise becomes a five-section line.
去掉任何一段都不行：没有原料、触媒中毒、未反应的气白白放掉。: No section can be dropped: without one there is no feedstock, the catalyst is poisoned, or unreacted gas is simply vented.
常考「为什么合成氨要分这么多工段」：答案落到「速率与平衡互相让步」和「每段替下一: Common question "why does ammonia synthesis need so many sections": the answer is "rate and equilibrium give way to each other" and "each section solves a problem for the next".
反应可逆、放热、气体分子数减少：要同时照顾「快」和「多」，所以拆成五个工段（见下: Reversible, exothermic, fewer gas molecules: to look after both "fast" and "more" it is split into five sections (see the breadcrumb below).
为什么第一件事是把原料气洗干净？: Why is the first job to clean the feed gas?
把「原料气净化」关掉，盯住触媒活性；过一会儿再打开: Turn "feed gas purification" off, watch the catalyst activity, then turn it back on after a while
触媒活性随时间下降；重新打开后回不到 100 %——活性上限已经被压低（永久中毒: Catalyst activity drops over time; after turning it back on it does not return to 100 %: the activity ceiling has been lowered (permanent poisoning)
ΔH ≈ −41 kJ·mol⁻¹ · 铁铬系/铜锌系触媒 · 中温变换: ΔH ≈ −41 kJ·mol⁻¹ · Fe-Cr / Cu-Zn catalyst · medium-temperature shift
硫、磷、砷、氯是永久毒物，中毒后不可恢复；H₂O、CO、CO₂、O₂ 是暂时毒物: Sulfur, phosphorus, arsenic and chlorine are permanent poisons, with no recovery; H₂O, CO, CO₂ and O₂ are temporary poisons.
变换反应一举两得：把 CO 变成 CO₂ 除掉，同时多产一份 H₂。: The shift reaction does two jobs: it turns CO into CO₂ to be removed, and makes an extra share of H₂.
脱碳还防低温段干冰堵塞，也防 CO₂ 稀释气体、拖慢反应。: Decarbonization also prevents dry ice blocking the cold sections, and stops CO₂ diluting the gas and slowing the reaction.
去掉这一步：触媒活性一路掉到 0.35 以下，产率持续下跌，只能停车换触媒。: Without this step: catalyst activity falls below 0.35, output keeps dropping, and the plant must stop to replace the catalyst.
考「为什么必须净化」时，答案要落到保护催化剂（和防堵塞），不要只说「除杂」。: For "why must the gas be purified", the answer must be protecting the catalyst (and preventing blockage), not just "removing impurities".
原料气里的硫等杂质会让铁触媒中毒，有的中毒不可逆；所以先脱硫、变换、脱碳: Sulfur and other impurities in the feed gas poison the iron catalyst, some irreversibly; so desulfurize, shift and decarbonize first
为什么要把压力压到几十个大气压？: Why squeeze the pressure up to hundreds of atmospheres?
把系统压力从 25 MPa 拖到 10 MPa: Drag the system pressure from 25 MPa down to 10 MPa
本步无化学反应：4 mol 气体 → 2 mol 气体，加压使平衡正移: No chemical reaction in this step: 4 mol of gas → 2 mol of gas, so pressure shifts the equilibrium forward
教材数据表（400 ℃）：10 MPa 25.1 % → 30 MPa 47.0: Textbook data table (400 ℃): 10 MPa 25.1 % → 30 MPa 47.0 % → 60 MPa 65.2 %, diminishing returns.
为什么不再高：塔壁应力大、厚壁设备造价高、压缩功耗电，还要防氢脆。: Why not higher: large stress in the tower wall, costly thick-walled equipment, compression consumes power, and hydrogen embrittlement must be prevented.
先净化后压缩：否则杂质被一起压缩，多耗能，触媒照样中毒。: Purify before compressing: otherwise the impurities are compressed too, wasting energy, and the catalyst is still poisoned.
去掉这一步：常压 500 ℃ 时平衡混合物里 NH₃ 只有 0.10 %，几乎没: Without this step: at atmospheric pressure and 500 ℃ the equilibrium mixture holds only 0.10 % NH₃, almost worthless industrially.
「压强为什么取 10～30 MPa」要答三条：平衡正移、速率加快、设备与能耗可承: "Why 10–30 MPa" needs three points: equilibrium shifts forward, rate increases, equipment and energy costs are bearable.
反应后气体分子数减少，加压使平衡右移、速率加快；但压力越高，设备和能耗越贵，所以: The reaction reduces the number of gas molecules, so pressure shifts the equilibrium right and speeds it up; but the higher the pressure, the costlier the equipment and energy, so 10–30 MPa is used
温度越低平衡越好，为什么偏要 400～500 ℃？: Lower temperature means better equilibrium. Why insist on 400–500 ℃?
把床层温度从 450 ℃ 拖到 400 ℃（本步压力已切到 30 MPa）: Drag the bed temperature from 450 ℃ down to 400 ℃ (pressure is already 30 MPa in this step)
NH₃ 平衡含量升到 46.9 %，产率反而降到 12.9 t/h；对照 500: NH₃ equilibrium content rises to 46.9 %, but output falls to 12.9 t/h; compare 500 ℃: 26.4 % / 33.0 t/h
放热 + 气体分子数减少：低温高压对平衡有利（200 ℃、100 MPa 可达: Exothermic + fewer gas molecules: low temperature and high pressure favor equilibrium (200 ℃ and 100 MPa reach 98.8 %).
但温度低速率太慢、铁触媒 400 ℃ 以下几乎没活性，所以折中取 400～500: But at low temperature the rate is too slow and the iron catalyst is almost inactive below 400 ℃, so the compromise is 400–500 ℃.
催化剂只加快到达平衡，不改变平衡转化率，也不改变 ΔH。: A catalyst only speeds up reaching equilibrium; it does not change the equilibrium conversion or ΔH.
去掉这一步：没有氨，前面三步全部白做。: Without this step: no ammonia, and the first three steps were all for nothing.
必考陷阱：催化剂「提高转化率」是错的；它只缩短达到平衡的时间。: Classic trap: a catalyst "increases conversion" is wrong; it only shortens the time to reach equilibrium.
低温平衡好但反应太慢；高温快但平衡差；铁触媒在 400–500 ℃ 活性最好，这: Low temperature gives better equilibrium but too slow a reaction; high temperature is fast but the equilibrium is poor; the iron catalyst works best at 400–500 ℃, which is the compromise
合成塔里面长什么样，热是怎么压住的？: What does the inside of the synthesis tower look like, and how is the heat kept down?
把床层温度推过 500 ℃（推到 560 ℃ 附近），看剖面床层和风险指数: Push the bed temperature past 500 ℃ (to around 560 ℃) and watch the cutaway beds and the risk index
四段床层颜色变深、越过 500 ℃ 后亮红；温度再往上走，风险指数从 560 ℃: The four beds darken and turn bright red past 500 ℃; as the temperature climbs further, the risk index starts rising from 560 ℃
ΔH = −92.4 kJ·mol⁻¹（放热）· 四段催化床、段间冷激: ΔH = −92.4 kJ·mol⁻¹ (exothermic) · four catalyst beds, inter-bed quench
段间冷激气控温: Quench gas between beds controls temperature
合成塔通常分 4 段催化床，段间打入冷激气，把床层温升压住。: A synthesis tower usually has 4 catalyst beds, with quench gas injected between them to hold down the temperature rise.
放热反应：不控温，床层会一路飞升，铁晶粒再结晶长大、活性下降。: Exothermic reaction: without temperature control the beds keep heating up, iron grains recrystallize and grow, and activity falls.
催化剂只加快到达平衡；床层怎么分段都不改变平衡转化率。: A catalyst only speeds up reaching equilibrium; however the beds are split, the equilibrium conversion does not change.
去掉冷激：床层温度失控 → 触媒烧结 → 塔体蠕变，这条链正是 640 ℃ 联锁: Without quench: bed temperature runs away → catalyst sinters → the tower creeps; this chain is exactly what the 640 ℃ interlock guards against.
「为什么分四段、段间要冷却」＝放热反应的温升必须分段移走，否则触媒烧结。: "Why four beds with cooling between them" = the temperature rise of an exothermic reaction must be removed stage by stage, or the catalyst sinters.
塔内分四段催化床，段间打入冷激气控温，避免烧坏触媒；催化剂只加快速率，不改变平衡: The tower has four catalyst beds with quench gas between them to control temperature and avoid burning out the catalyst; the catalyst only speeds up the rate and does not change the equilibrium
每次只转化一小部分，为什么总利用率能到 97 %？: Each pass converts only a small part. How does total utilization reach 97 %?
把「循环」切断，看利用率与产率怎么掉: Cut the "recycle" and see how utilization and output drop
原料利用率从 97.0 % 掉到 33.4 %（模型值），产率 26.8 → 约: Feed utilization drops from 97.0 % to 33.4 % (model value), output 26.8 → about 11 t/h
加压降温液化 · 约 −20 ℃ 分离: Liquefy by pressure and cooling · separate at about −20 ℃
循环压缩机送回: Sent back by the recycle compressor
单程只有约 15 %，不分离循环就等于把大部分原料放空。: A single pass converts only about 15 %; without separation and recycling most of the feed is vented.
氨容易液化（沸点很低），所以「加压 + 降温」两条路都能把它变成液体。: Ammonia liquefies easily (low boiling point), so both "pressure" and "cooling" can turn it into a liquid.
循环把原料利用率提到约 97 %，但平衡转化率一点没变。: Recycling raises feed utilization to about 97 %, but the equilibrium conversion does not change at all.
去掉这一步：原料利用率大幅下跌，成本翻几倍，氨也拿不出来。: Without this step: feed utilization falls sharply, costs multiply, and the ammonia cannot be recovered.
必考混淆：循环提高的是原料利用率，不是平衡转化率。: Classic confusion: recycling raises feed utilization, not equilibrium conversion.
冷却分出液氨，未反应的 N₂、H₂ 送回去再反应；它提高的是原料利用率，不是平衡: Cooling separates liquid ammonia, and unreacted N₂ and H₂ are sent back to react again; this raises feed utilization, not equilibrium conversion.
考核：你来当班长——能不能把产率稳住，又不出事故？: Assessment: you are the shift leader. Can you hold output steady without an accident?
在教材区间内让氨产率 ≥ 24 t/h 并保持 15 s；本班会先出一次「温度偏: Keep ammonia output ≥ 24 t/h within the textbook ranges and hold for 15 s; your shift starts with a "temperature too low" fault
达标横幅「产率稳定在 24 t/h 以上」；越过 640 ℃ 或 38 MPa: Success banner "output steady above 24 t/h"; going past 640 ℃ or 38 MPa triggers "3-second countdown → incident → review → repair"
温度、压强都要落在教材区间：400–500 ℃、10–30 MPa。: Temperature and pressure must both be within the textbook ranges: 400–500 ℃, 10–30 MPa.
产率靠「条件 + 触媒活性 + 循环」一起撑：任一处掉链子，读数立刻掉。: Output depends on "conditions + catalyst activity + recycle" together: if any one fails, the reading drops at once.
越界就有代价：床层 640 ℃ 或系统 38 MPa 会走「倒计时 → 事故 →: Going out of range has a cost: bed 640 ℃ or system 38 MPa triggers "countdown → incident → review".
没有新结论：把前六步的条件同时照顾到，就是全部。: No new conclusion: looking after the conditions of the first six steps all at once is all there is.
考试里「工业条件怎么选」的满分答法：先摆速率与平衡的矛盾，再逐条给折中的理由。: Full-marks answer to "how are industrial conditions chosen": first state the conflict between rate and equilibrium, then give the reason for each compromise.
考核没有新结论：把前面六步的条件同时照顾到——温度、压力落在教材区间，净化与循环: The assessment has no new conclusion: look after the conditions of the previous six steps at the same time: temperature and pressure within the textbook ranges, purification and recycle both on.
天然气与水蒸气造 H₂，空气分馏出 N₂: H₂ from natural gas and steam, N₂ from air separation
脱硫 → 变换 → 脱碳，把毒物清干净: Desulfurize → shift → decarbonize, removing the poisons
多级压缩到 10～30 MPa，级间冷却: Multi-stage compression to 10–30 MPa, with intercooling
铁触媒上合成氨，反应热要马上移走: Ammonia forms on the iron catalyst; the heat of reaction must be removed at once
降温液化分出液氨，未反应气回炉: Cool and liquefy to separate liquid ammonia; unreacted gas goes back
本班目标：氨产率 ≥ 24 t/h，保持 15 秒: Shift target: ammonia output ≥ 24 t/h, held for 15 seconds
超温 → 合成塔破裂燃爆: Overheating → synthesis tower ruptures and explodes
A. 为压住「转化率低」的报警持续升温: A. Temperature keeps being raised to silence the "low conversion" alarm
速率是快了，但平衡在往左走，产量反而掉。: The rate is faster, but the equilibrium is shifting left, and output actually falls.
B. 床层越过 640 ℃，铁晶粒再结晶长大: B. The bed passes 640 ℃ and iron grains recrystallize and grow
触媒比表面下降，活性骤降；钢材高温强度大幅下降。: The catalyst's specific surface shrinks and activity collapses; the steel loses much of its strength at high temperature.
C. 触媒烧结 + 塔壁蠕变: C. Catalyst sintering + tower wall creep
床层局部飞温，内件密封失效；高温高压氢渗入钢中，塔壁变脆鼓胀。: Local hot spots in the bed, internal seals fail; hot high-pressure hydrogen enters the steel, and the wall turns brittle and bulges.
D. 塔体破裂、氢气泄漏燃爆: D. Tower ruptures, hydrogen leaks and explodes
高压 H₂ 喷出，遇空气着火爆炸，装置报废。: High-pressure H₂ jets out, ignites in air and explodes; the unit is written off.
床层多点热电偶 + 640 ℃ 超温联锁：自动切断加热、开大冷激气: Multi-point bed thermocouples + 640 ℃ over-temperature interlock: automatically cut heating and open the quench gas
层间冷激与废热锅炉移热，把床层稳定在 400～500 ℃: Inter-bed quench and waste-heat boiler remove heat, keeping the beds at 400–500 ℃
内外筒结构：内件耐高温，外筒只承压、保持较低壁温: Inner and outer shell design: internals withstand heat, the outer shell only holds pressure and stays cooler
定期测壁温壁厚、无损探伤，触媒按周期更换: Regular wall temperature and thickness checks, non-destructive testing, catalyst replaced on schedule
记住这条链：升温 → 触媒烧结 → 塔体蠕变 → 破裂。温度不是越高越好。: Remember this chain: heating → catalyst sinters → tower creeps → rupture. Hotter is not better.
A. 为提高平衡含量持续升压: A. Pressure keeps being raised to increase equilibrium content
平衡确实在往右走，但收益递减，风险在累加。: The equilibrium does shift right, but returns diminish while the risk piles up.
B. 越过 38 MPa 设计压力: B. Past the 38 MPa design pressure
法兰垫片塑性变形，螺栓松弛，密封先失效。: Flange gaskets deform plastically, bolts relax, and the seals fail first.
可燃气体报警，塔壁环向应力超过材料许用值。: The flammable gas alarm sounds; hoop stress in the tower wall exceeds the material's allowable value.
泄漏的 H₂、NH₃ 遇火源，装置停车、人员撤离。: Leaking H₂ and NH₃ meet an ignition source; the unit stops and people evacuate.
安全阀 + 爆破片：超压自动泄放，定压在 38 MPa 以下: Safety valve + bursting disc: automatic release on overpressure, set below 38 MPa
压力联锁：自动降压并停压缩机: Pressure interlock: automatically depressurize and stop the compressor
设计压力留足裕量，操作压强控制在 10～30 MPa: Design pressure with ample margin; operating pressure kept at 10–30 MPa
定期测壁厚、无损探伤，重点查焊缝与法兰: Regular wall thickness checks and non-destructive testing, focusing on welds and flanges
记住这条链：升压 → 密封失效 → 氢泄漏 → 破裂。压强有物理上限，也有成本上: Remember this chain: pressure up → seals fail → hydrogen leaks → rupture. Pressure has a physical limit and a cost limit.

本课目标：把氨产率稳在 24 t/h 以上并保持 15 秒；把参数推过 640: Lesson goal: hold ammonia output above 24 t/h for 15 seconds; pushing past 640 ℃ or 38 MPa causes an incident, which you must understand through the review before repairing.
工业合成氨所需 H₂ 的主要来源是: The main source of H₂ for industrial ammonia synthesis is
天然气（或煤）与水蒸气反应: Reaction of natural gas (or coal) with steam
工业上用天然气（或煤）与水蒸气在高温、催化剂下转化制 H₂；电解水耗电太多、成本: Industry makes H₂ by converting natural gas (or coal) with steam at high temperature over a catalyst; electrolysis uses too much power and costs too much. Liquefying and fractionating air gives N₂.
原料气进入合成塔前必须净化，主要原因是: The feed gas must be purified before entering the synthesis tower, mainly to
硫化物、CO 等杂质会占据铁触媒的活性位点使其中毒失效。净化不改变平衡，只保护催: Sulfides, CO and other impurities occupy the active sites of the iron catalyst and poison it. Purification does not change the equilibrium; it only protects the catalyst.
变换反应 CO(g) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO₂(g) + H₂(g) 在合成: In the ammonia process, the shift reaction CO(g) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO₂(g) + H₂(g)
除去 CO，同时增加 H₂ 并调好氢氮比: removes CO, adds H₂ and adjusts the hydrogen-to-nitrogen ratio
变换反应把 CO 转化成容易除掉的 CO₂，同时每 1 mol CO 多产 1: The shift reaction turns CO into easily removed CO₂, and each 1 mol of CO makes 1 extra mol of H₂, helping bring H₂∶N₂ close to 3.
合成氨采用 10～30 MPa 的高压，主要理由是: Ammonia synthesis uses a high pressure of 10–30 MPa mainly because
高压使平衡常数增大: high pressure increases the equilibrium constant
气体分子数减少，加压使平衡正移，同时加快反应: gas molecules decrease, so pressure shifts the equilibrium forward and also speeds up the reaction
高压使反应变为放热: high pressure makes the reaction exothermic
4 mol 气体 → 2 mol 气体，加压使平衡向生成 NH₃ 的方向移动，浓: mol of gas → 2 mol of gas, so pressure shifts the equilibrium toward NH₃, and the higher concentrations also speed up the reaction. The equilibrium constant changes only with temperature.
选择 400～500 ℃ 的主要原因是: The main reason for choosing 400–500 ℃ is
此温度下平衡转化率最高: the equilibrium conversion is highest at this temperature
正反应吸热，需要高温: the forward reaction is endothermic and needs heat
兼顾速率与限度，且铁触媒在此温度活性较好: it balances rate and extent, and the iron catalyst is quite active at this temperature
正反应放热，低温平衡更有利但速率太慢、触媒活性不足；400～500 ℃ 是速率、: The forward reaction is exothermic; low temperature favors equilibrium but the rate is too slow and the catalyst is not active enough; 400–500 ℃ is a compromise between rate, extent and catalyst activity.
使用铁触媒后，合成氨反应的: With an iron catalyst, the ammonia synthesis reaction's
达到平衡的时间缩短，平衡转化率不变: time to reach equilibrium is shorter, and equilibrium conversion is unchanged
催化剂同等程度加快正、逆反应，只缩短达到平衡的时间；平衡常数只随温度变化，ΔH: A catalyst speeds up the forward and reverse reactions equally and only shortens the time to equilibrium; the equilibrium constant depends only on temperature, and ΔH is set by the initial and final states.
把未反应的 N₂、H₂ 循环送回合成塔，主要目的是: Recycling unreacted N₂ and H₂ back to the synthesis tower mainly
循环让没反应的原料再进塔，提高总利用率（可达约 97%），但平衡转化率只由温度、: Recycling sends unreacted feed back into the tower and raises total utilization (to about 97 %), but equilibrium conversion depends only on temperature, pressure and ratio, and is not changed by recycling.
既能加快合成氨反应速率、又能使平衡正向移动的措施是: A measure that both speeds up ammonia synthesis and shifts the equilibrium forward is
增大压强同时提高浓度（速率加快）并使气体分子数减少的方向（生成氨）移动。升温只加: Increasing pressure raises concentrations (faster rate) and shifts toward fewer gas molecules (ammonia). Heating only speeds up the rate and shifts the equilibrium backward; a catalyst does not shift the equilibrium; removing ammonia only shifts the equilibrium without changing the rate.
达产成功：产率稳定在 24 t/h 以上: Target reached: output steady above 24 t/h
净化关闭：硫进入合成塔，触媒开始中毒: Purification off: sulfur enters the tower and the catalyst starts to be poisoned
净化恢复：活性回到已降低的上限: Purification restored: activity back to its lowered ceiling
触媒未装：几乎不生成氨（平衡值不变）: Catalyst not loaded: almost no ammonia forms (equilibrium value unchanged)
抢修完成：换塔、复位参数，重新开车: Repair done: tower replaced, parameters reset, restarting
循环已投用：未反应气送回压缩机，利用率回到 97 %: Recycle in service: unreacted gas goes back to the compressor and utilization returns to 97 %
循环已切断：未反应气放空，利用率大幅下跌: Recycle cut off: unreacted gas is vented and utilization falls sharply
异常：床层 385 ℃ 低于教材区间（400–500 ℃）——先升温再谈达标: Fault: bed at 385 ℃ is below the textbook range (400–500 ℃); raise the temperature before aiming for the target
紧急停车：泄压降温，联锁解除: Emergency stop: depressurize and cool, interlock released

这是合成塔 R-401：立式厚壁圆筒，塔顶椭圆封头压在主法兰上，一串螺栓把内件检: This is synthesis tower R-401: a vertical thick-walled cylinder; an elliptical head sits on the main flange at the top, and a ring of bolts seals the internals' access port; at the bottom it stands on the platform on a skirt.
剖开四分之一看进去：塔壳里面是触媒筐，四段催化剂床自上而下叠着，段与段之间留出空: Cut away a quarter and look inside: inside the shell is the catalyst basket, with four catalyst beds stacked top to bottom and gaps between them; it is not one solid block of orange.
四段床的温度并不一样：越往上越热，一段 {$0} ℃ 到四段 {$1} ℃；叠加: The four beds are not the same temperature: the higher, the hotter, from {$0} ℃ in bed 1 to {$1} ℃ in bed 4; the deeper the amber overlay, the hotter that bed.
两层床之间有一股冷激气从塔壁斜插进来，把下一段的入口温度压回去，反应才不至于沿塔: Between two beds a stream of quench gas enters slanting through the wall, pulling the inlet temperature of the next bed back down, so the reaction does not keep heating up along the tower.
反应后的气体在塔底的分离空间汇成一股，沿中心管一路上升，从塔顶接管出塔；夹带的触: The reacted gas gathers in the separation space at the bottom of the tower, rises up the central pipe and leaves through the top nozzle; entrained catalyst dust also settles in this bottom space.
标注 · 中心管出气: Label · gas out through the central pipe
把温度滑杆往上推：琥珀变深，平衡装得下的氨变少，出塔氨含量跟着降；越过 500: Push the temperature slider up: the amber deepens, less ammonia fits in the equilibrium, and the outlet ammonia content falls; past 500 ℃ it turns red, the top of the textbook range.
外层先让开 → 四段床层沿塔轴依次分开（最上一段先走）→ 保持并缓慢漂移 → 复: The outer layer moves aside first → the four beds separate one by one along the tower axis (top bed first) → hold and drift slowly → reassemble; dashed lines are ghosts of the original positions and guide lines.
